message: さあ、生徒会活動の始まりだ！

name: Synn
message: 「All right! Since everyone's gathered, let's get the meeting started right away.」

name: Misa
message: 「Aside from Azel-san, we have a mountain of regular agenda items. Now that the handover is finished, it's finally time for the real thing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so excited. I'm really looking forward to it~」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's do our best and aim for a sparkling, shining school life!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, let's get right to it and decide what we're going to do from here on--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Me, me! Let's put together the budget!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, Nanaka. It's rare to see you so eager about something difficult.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, yeah.」

name: Misa
message: 「Aren't you scheming something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「C-Could it be an evil plot... My heart's pounding.\s05」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~. I'm curious what kind of evil plot it is~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, all of you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even I think properly and seriously about the Student Council, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Your cheeks are relaxing into a grin.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, no way!?」

name: Ria
message: 「So you really are aware of it.\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Our treasurer being loose and relaxed is the usual thing, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ho-ho~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll just have to punish Lolo-chan's naughty mouth, won't I~」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, playtime is over. Starting today, we're going to do things seriously and properly. As long as I'm in this Student Council, I will never tolerate any fooling around!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case, let's do the budget together♪ Financial audits and house searches♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan. You do understand what Student Council activities are supposed to be about, right...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Does anyone else have any ideas?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since we're part of the Student Council, I'd love to try doing things that can be of even greater help to everyone.」

name: Misa
message: 「My, that's quite a lovely idea.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Unlike a certain someone'--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that what you're tryna say!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, you're jumping way ahead of yourself.」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you mean something like volunteer work?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it means helping people in trouble, I'm willing to do anything.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I got it! How about we call it the 'Helping Hands Brigade'!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, that's way too simplistic.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san. That's a wonderful name and very close, actually, but I have already come up with a name for our organization.」

name: Ria
message: 「Amazing. You really came prepared, Lolotte-chan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Its name is 'Angelic Agent'」

name: Ria
message: 「Angelic... Agent... I see.\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And mine was the simplistic one?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Any other ideas--」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on a second. New ideas are all well and good, but you're forgetting our most important annual event.」

name: Ria
message: 「You mean the yearly Charity Bazaar, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! R-Right, that's coming up...」

name: Misa
message: 「You really ought to keep track of basic things like this. You're the Student Council President, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... S-Sorry.」

name: Misa
message: 「As the student council president, you're supposed to be more reliable than me. Make sure you're properly aware of that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, got it. Then let's review the annual events first.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're a first-year, Lolo-chan, so this is your first time, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I don't understand any of it at all! But I'm really looking forward to it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, that's a super refreshing and great smile!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though we've only done it once ourselves, so we actually don't really get it either!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's hardly something to brag about.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see, there's the entrance ceremony, the graduation ceremony... um, and after that--」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. Isn't thinking about a whole year's worth of events all at once a little tough?」

name: Synn
message: 「Good point.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just as Senpai says. Ryuusei Academy's biggest event is waiting for us in December, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The Holy Night Festival, huh. Last year we were participants, so this year we're gonna be the organizers, huh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A festival on Christmas... I have a feeling it's going to be wonderful!」

name: Misa
message: 「Though I also have a feeling it's going to be terribly exhausting in return.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we get too greedy our heads'll explode, so shall we narrow it down?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He who chases two hares wins first prize, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. For now, let's plan out the schedule up until the school festival.」

name: Ria
message: 「On October 27th, there's the Charity Bazaar.」

name: Ria
message: 「And then... November 19th and 20th are second-term midterms.」

name: Ria
message: 「On November 30th, the first regular student general assembly.」

name: Ria
message: 「And then on Christmas Eve, December 24th, is the Holy Night Festival, I think.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Impressive as expected, Senpai-san.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem!

name: Ria
message: I have been properly attending this school for three years, after all」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's totally normal stuff, though--Ria-chan, you're the best!」

name: Synn
message: 「Annual events, Student Council duties... Everything's a first for us, so let's just jump in and try doing something!」
